name: privacy-scan
description: Scan a directory tree for personal data and secrets that shouldn't be committed: private/LAN IPv4 addresses, home-directory paths (/home/*, /Users/*, C:\Users\*), emails, API-token shapes (sk-, ghp_, AKIA, JWTs, Bearer), private keys, MAC addresses. Gitignored files are skipped; doc IP ranges and 127.x are allowed. Extra personal patterns load from a local file so names never live in the repo.
use_when: checking a repo for leaked personal data, secrets, or private IPs before committing or publishing

args.name: --patterns
args.description: Extra pattern file; one literal or 'regex:...' per line. Repeatable.

env.AGENT_TOOLS_HOME: State root; default pattern file lives there.

stdout: JSON {ok, root, scanned, hits: [{file, line, kind, match, text}]}.
notes: Keep personal names/hosts in $AGENT_TOOLS_HOME/privacy-patterns.txt — never in the repo itself.
